issues.issue: Split part printed as 'Interest income' on the Statement of Activities. Under the user rule of 2026-10-23, interest lines are category 'Interest Income'; 'investment income' is only for dividends and gains.

issues.issue: The balance-sheet basis rule (user, 2026-10-27) says cash-basis reports take governmental balance-sheet lines from the governmental funds statement (Total column, fund balance by classification) when its totals equal the government-wide totals. They do here (6,156,413). The equity lines should come from p3, which adds the Committed line of 1,204,562 and makes Unassigned 3,864,658. The assets are the same on both pages.

issues.issue: The extractor rule says a combining schedule with more than 6 fund columns uses its Total column (fund = 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'). The per-fund rule of 2026-10-27 covers only cities and villages. The per-fund lines do tie to the Total column, and there is no double counting.
'Local' is a broad group that mixes fees, interest and miscellaneous receipts. Charges are probably the dominant part. The line already has a review note.
